value.summary: Adds a `reasoning_effort` field as a plain `String` without validation. This risks upstream breakage or silent misconfiguration. No security issue introduced.

findings.title: Constrain reasoning_effort to accepted values
findings.body: The doc comment defines only `off`, `low`, `medium`, `high` as valid, but the type is `String`. Any value compiles and is silently forwarded to the API. Use an enum or validate at the boundary.
